description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Image_Graph_Layout' which extends another class and provides layout and positioning functionalities for graphical elements within the Image_Graph library. It includes methods for calculating edges, updating coordinates, and managing alignment, functioning as part of a larger graph rendering utility.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout
classes.description: An abstract class representing a layout element within the graph, enabling positioning and sizing of layout areas on a graph canvas.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the object and setting default padding.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the layout state, marking the layout as not updated.

methods.name: _calcEdgeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for a specific edge based on alignment size, total size, and direction multiplier.

methods.name: _calcEdges
methods.description: Calculates and sets the coordinates for the layout edges based on alignment settings.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the element's coordinates by recalculating edges and then calling the parent update method.

methods.name: _push
methods.description: Sets alignment of a specific edge either as a percentage or pixel value, affecting layout positioning.

methods.name: _setCoords
methods.description: Sets the coordinates of the layout element and marks it as updated.

methods.name: _getAutoSize
methods.description: Returns the auto size (currently always false).
